correctness.rationale: For connected noncomplete SRG with mu>0, the standard adjacency identity gives L(tI+A)=QI-mu J, with t=k-lambda+mu and Q=v mu. Thus the star-edge transfer-current kernel at root u is K=[tI+A(H_u)+(t-2)J]/Q, whose eigenvalues are 1 and (t+theta_j)/Q for j>=2. The determinantal UST edge law yields the exact rooted-degree PGF z product_j(1+(t+theta_j)(z-1)/Q); all Bernoulli factors nonzero since the entire star can occur in a spanning tree. Therefore fixed parameters allow recovering the neighborhood adjacency spectrum. The first two spectral power sums are fixed; trace A(H)^3=6 times neighborhood triangle count yields third factorial cumulant difference 12 Delta triangles/Q^3. The rook/Shri local graphs K3 disjoint K3 versus C6 give the stated exact PGFs, difference z(z-1)^3(5z+27)^2/2^23, third difference 3/4096. Independent exact polynomial factorization checked and original verifier’s weighted matrix-tree code was read.
